```{r functions}
# useful function
convert_meta_genes <- function(gene_vector) {
  # Identify meta genes in the input vector
  meta_genes <- gene_vector[grepl("meta", gene_vector)]
  non_meta_genes <- gene_vector[!grepl("meta", gene_vector)]
  
  # Convert meta genes to actual gene names using metagene_dict
  meta_to_gene <- metagene_dict$name[metagene_dict$meta %in% meta_genes]
  
  # Combine non-meta genes and converted meta genes, ensuring uniqueness
  converted_genes <- unique(c(non_meta_genes, meta_to_gene))
  
  return(converted_genes)
}
niceKmeans <-function (df, k, kmeans.algorithm = "Lloyd", iter.max = 1000, nstart=100) {
  
  result = data.frame();
  source = t(scale(t(df)));
  kmeans = kmeans(source, centers = k, iter.max = iter.max, algorithm=kmeans.algorithm, nstart=nstart);
  clustered = data.frame();
  breaks = c();
  for (i in 1:k) {
    print(sprintf("Doing cluster %i",i))
    cluster = source[kmeans$cluster==i,];
    rows = row.names(cluster);
    clust = heatmap.2(as.matrix(cluster), distfun=function(x) as.dist((1-cor(t(x)))/2))
    cluster.ordered = cluster[clust$rowInd,];
    cluster.ordered.genes = rows[clust$rowInd];
    row.names(cluster.ordered) = cluster.ordered.genes;
    class = data.frame(row.names=cluster.ordered.genes);
    class[,"class"] = i 
    cluster.ordered = cbind(cluster.ordered, class);
    clustered = rbind(clustered, cluster.ordered);
    if(i > 1 & i < k) {
      breaks[i] = as.numeric(breaks[i-1]) + length(rows);
    } else if(i==1) {
      breaks[i] = length(rows);
    }
  }
  
  result <- list();
  result$clustered <- clustered;
  result$breaks <- breaks;
  return(result);
}

create_table <- function(Dir, file_lst) {
  f=file_lst[1]
  sample=gsub("_sorted_esat\\.txt\\.gene\\.txt","",f)
  df <- read.table(paste0(Dir,"/",f), sep="\t", header=TRUE) %>% 
    tidyr::unite( .,"region",c("Symbol","chr","strand"),sep=";",remove=TRUE) %>% 
    mutate(sum=rowSums(select_if(., is.numeric))) %>%
    dplyr::select(c("region",sum)) %>% 
    magrittr::set_colnames(c("region",sample))
  
  if (length(file_lst) > 1) {
    for (f in file_lst[2:length(file_lst)]) {
      sample=gsub("_sorted_esat\\.txt\\.gene\\.txt","",f)
      df.this <- read.table(paste0(Dir,"/",f), sep="\t", header=TRUE) %>% 
        tidyr::unite( .,"region",c("Symbol","chr","strand"),sep=";",remove=TRUE) %>% 
        mutate(sum=rowSums(select_if(., is.numeric))) %>%
        dplyr::select(c("region",sum)) %>% 
        magrittr::set_colnames(c("region",sample))
    
    df <- dplyr::left_join(df,df.this,by="region")
    }
  }
  df <- df %>% tibble::column_to_rownames( . , "region")
  return(df)
  rm(f,sample,df,df.this)
}

create_umi_table <- function(Dir, file_lst) {
  samples <- gsub("_sorted\\.umi\\.distributions\\.txt$", "", file_lst)

  umi.long <- lapply(seq_along(file_lst), function(k) {
    data.table::fread(file.path(Dir, file_lst[k]), header = FALSE,
                      col.names = c("barcode", "gene", "umi", "reads")) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(sample = samples[k])
  }) %>% data.table::rbindlist()

  umi.long %>%
    dplyr::distinct(sample, barcode, gene, umi) %>%      # one row per unique molecule
    dplyr::count(sample, gene, name = "n_umi") %>%       # distinct UMIs per gene, summed over barcodes
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = n_umi, values_fill = 0) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene, dplyr::all_of(samples)) %>%      # keep file order, like create_table
    tibble::column_to_rownames("gene") %>%
    as.data.frame()
}

convert_to_entrez <- function(gene_list) {
  bitr(gene_list, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)
}
convert_from_entrez <- function(id_list) {
  bitr(id_list, fromType = "ENTREZID", toType = "SYMBOL", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)
}

plot_paired_plot <- function(gene){
  g=gene
  df <- data.frame(CPM = as.numeric(t(CPM.clean[g,])), 
                   sample = colnames(CPM.clean)) %>%
    left_join(. , metadata[,c("sample","donor","celltype","condition")], by="sample")
  
  df.ifng <- df %>% dplyr::filter(condition%in%c("PBS","IFNG"))
  df.ifnb <- df %>% dplyr::filter(condition%in%c("PBS","IFNB"))
  df.tnf <- df %>% dplyr::filter(condition%in%c("PBS","TNF"))
  
  # make paired plots
  position <- "identity"; width = 0.5; point.size = 2; line.size = 0.5
  line.color = "grey"; linetype = "solid"; palette="bright"
  
  p.ifng <- ggplot(df.ifng, create_aes(list(x = "condition", y = "CPM"))) +
    geom_exec(geom_point, data = df.ifng, color = "condition", size = point.size,
              position = "jitter") +
    scale_color_manual(values=c("#999999","#E69F00"))+
    labs(title=g)+
    theme(legend.position="none") +
    facet_wrap(~ celltype)
  
  p.ifnb <- ggplot(df.ifnb, create_aes(list(x = "condition", y = "CPM"))) +
    geom_exec(geom_line, data = df.ifnb, group = "donor",
              color = line.color, size = line.size, linetype = linetype,
              position = position) +
    geom_exec(geom_point, data = df.ifnb, color = "condition", size = point.size,
              position = position) +
    scale_color_manual(values=c("#999999","darkgreen"))+
    labs(title=g)+
    theme(legend.position="none") +
    facet_wrap(~ celltype)
  
  p.tnf <- ggplot(df.tnf, create_aes(list(x = "condition", y = "CPM"))) +
    geom_exec(geom_line, data = df.tnf, group = "donor",
              color = line.color, size = line.size, linetype = linetype,
              position = position) +
    geom_exec(geom_point, data = df.tnf, color = "condition", size = point.size,
              position = position) +
    scale_color_manual(values=c("#999999","purple"))+
    labs(title=g)+
    theme(legend.position="none") +
    facet_wrap(~ celltype)
  
  final_plot <- plot_grid(
    p.ifng, p.ifnb, p.tnf,
    nrow = 1, ncol = 3
  )
  
  return(final_plot)
}
```

## Overview
Celseq2 RNAseq data from skin-eQTL data. phase1 and phase2 fastq files were processed, aligned, and counted by Via Foundry's ESAT 3.0 pipeline with custom genome with meta genes (ESAT is updated Oct 2026 to account for previous UMI overcollapsing)

## Load counts and UMIs before ESAT was updated
### phase1 samples mapped with oldESAT (no merged samples, lengths vary from 36bp to 56bp)
```{r load-phase1-countmatrix-oldESAT}
Dir.esat.list=c("/pi/manuel.garber-umw/human/skin/eQTLs/RNA-Seq/DolphinNext/phase1_rerun_customGenome/archive2025/report10996/ESAT",
                "/pi/manuel.garber-umw/human/skin/eQTLs/RNA-Seq/DolphinNext/phase1_rerun_customGenome/F44_KRT_PBS/report11029/ESAT")

counts.phase1.list <- list()
umis.phase1.list <- list()
metadata.phase1.list <- list()

# mitochondrial genes
MTgenes <- read.table("/pi/manuel.garber-umw/human/skin/eQTLs/literature/UCSC_tracks/Ensembl_GRCh38.105_mitochondrial_genes.txt")

for (i in 1:length(Dir.esat.list)) {
  # fetch ESAT directory
  Dir.esat=Dir.esat.list[i]
  
  # 1. import ESAT counts into master table
  flst <- list.files(path = Dir.esat, pattern = "esat.txt.gene.txt")
  counts <- create_table(Dir.esat, flst) %>% rownames_to_column("key") %>%
    tidyr::separate("key",into=c("gene",NA,NA),sep=";",remove=TRUE) %>% column_to_rownames("gene")
  col.sum = data.frame(sample = colnames(counts), samplesum = apply(counts,2,sum))
  
  # remove mitochondria genes
  counts <- counts %>% mutate(gene=rownames(.)) %>% 
    dplyr::filter(!rownames(.) %in% MTgenes$V1) %>% dplyr::select(-"gene")
  dim(counts)
  
  # 2. import UMI counts into master table (same layout as counts)
  ulst <- list.files(path = Dir.esat, pattern = "\\.umi\\.distributions\\.txt$")
  umis <- create_umi_table(Dir.esat, ulst)
  umis <- umis %>% dplyr::filter(!rownames(.) %in% MTgenes$V1)

  # align to the counts genes: genes with zero UMIs are absent from the UMI files
  umis <- umis[rownames(counts), , drop = FALSE]
  umis[is.na(umis)] <- 0
  rownames(umis) <- rownames(counts)
  
  # mapping summary
  info_alignment <- data.table::fread(paste0(Dir.esat,"/../summary/overall_summary.tsv")) %>%
    set_colnames(c("sample","total_reads","multimapped_reads_aligned","unique_reads_aligned")) %>%
    left_join( . , col.sum, by="sample") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(reads_aligned = multimapped_reads_aligned + unique_reads_aligned) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(all_aligned_reads_over_total = (multimapped_reads_aligned + unique_reads_aligned) / total_reads) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(unique_aligned_reads_over_total = unique_reads_aligned / total_reads)

  # metadata
  metadata <- info_alignment
  
  # populate large list
  counts.phase1.list[[i]] <- counts
  umis.phase1.list[[i]] <- umis
  metadata.phase1.list[[i]] <- metadata
  rm(counts, umis, metadata, info_alignment, col.sum, flst, ulst, Dir.esat)
}

# combine all data frames by column
counts.phase1 <- do.call(cbind, counts.phase1.list) %>%
  dplyr::select(-F42_KRT_PBS_S1)# this was accidentally included in the run, but I used NovaSeq data for this sample instead

umis.phase1 <- do.call(cbind, umis.phase1.list) %>%
  dplyr::select(-F42_KRT_PBS_S1)

# import metadata
temp <- data.table::fread("/pi/manuel.garber-umw/human/skin/eQTLs/RNA-Seq/metadata_phase1_selected_metadata_07082025.txt") %>% arrange(sample)
temp2 <- do.call(rbind, metadata.phase1.list) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!sample=="F42_KRT_PBS_S1") %>%
  arrange(sample) %>%
  mutate(CS2=NA)
metadata.phase1 <- left_join(temp, temp2, by="sample")
metadata.phase1 <- metadata.phase1[,c("sample","read_length","donor","celltype","condition","CS2",
                                      "phase","technical_rep","sequencing_platform",
                                      "total_reads","multimapped_reads_aligned","unique_reads_aligned",
                                      "samplesum","reads_aligned","all_aligned_reads_over_total","unique_aligned_reads_over_total")]

rm(counts.phase1.list, metadata.phase1.list, temp, temp2)
```

```{r load-56bp-oldESAT}
  # mapping summary
  info_alignment <- data.table::fread(paste0(Dir.esat,"/../summary/overall_summary.tsv")) %>%
    set_colnames(c("sample","total_reads","multimapped_reads_aligned","unique_reads_aligned")) %>%
    left_join( . , col.sum, by="sample") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(reads_aligned = multimapped_reads_aligned + unique_reads_aligned) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(all_aligned_reads_over_total = (multimapped_reads_aligned + unique_reads_aligned) / total_reads) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(unique_aligned_reads_over_total = unique_reads_aligned / total_reads)

  # metadata
  metadata <- info_alignment
  
  # populate large list
  counts.56bp.list[[i]] <- counts
  umis.56bp.list[[i]] <- umis
  metadata.56bp.list[[i]] <- metadata
  rm(counts, umis, metadata, info_alignment, col.sum, flst, ulst, Dir.esat)
}
# combine all data frames by column
counts.56bp <- do.call(cbind, counts.56bp.list)
umis.56bp <- do.call(cbind, umis.56bp.list)
metadata.56bp <- do.call(rbind, metadata.56bp.list)
metadata.56bp <- metadata.56bp[,c("sample","read_length","donor","celltype","condition","CS2",
                                      "phase","technical_rep","sequencing_platform",
                                      "total_reads","multimapped_reads_aligned","unique_reads_aligned",
                                      "samplesum","reads_aligned","all_aligned_reads_over_total","unique_aligned_reads_over_total")]

rm(counts.56bp.list, umis.56bp.list, metadata.56bp.list)
```
```{r compare counts_vs_umis in oldESATrun}
# same genes and samples, in the same order?
identical(rownames(counts.phase1), rownames(umis.phase1))
identical(colnames(counts.phase1), colnames(umis.phase1))

diff.mat <- as.matrix(counts.phase1) - as.matrix(umis.phase1)

# overall: how many entries disagree?
sum(diff.mat != 0)                 # number of gene x sample entries that differ
mean(diff.mat != 0)                # fraction of all entries
all.equal(as.matrix(counts.phase1), as.matrix(umis.phase1))   # TRUE if everything matches

# long table of every disagreement, largest first
disagree <- which(diff.mat != 0, arr.ind = TRUE)
disagree.df <- data.frame(
  gene   = rownames(diff.mat)[disagree[, "row"]],
  sample = colnames(diff.mat)[disagree[, "col"]],
  counts = as.matrix(counts.phase1)[disagree],
  umis   = as.matrix(umis.phase1)[disagree],
  diff   = diff.mat[disagree]
) %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs(diff)))
head(disagree.df, 20)

# per gene: in how many samples does it disagree?
gene.summary <- disagree.df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_samples = dplyr::n(), max_abs_diff = max(abs(diff))) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_samples))
head(gene.summary, 20)

# per sample: how many genes disagree?
sample.summary <- disagree.df %>% dplyr::count(sample, name = "n_genes") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_genes))
head(sample.summary, 20)
```

### re-create Manuel's UMI saturation plots
```{r plot}
## UMI saturation figure: 3 panels
##   A. one library: UMI CPM vs read CPM, with the 4,096-UMI ceiling
##   B. PBS fibroblasts: COL1A1 / ACTB CPM vs library size, UMI vs read CPM
##   C. IFIT1 log2 fold change (IFN vs PBS) per donor, UMIs vs reads
##
## Needs in the session: umis.phase1 and reads.phase1 (gene x sample,
## F42_KRT_PBS_S1 already dropped)
## Packages: dplyr, tidyr, ggplot2, ggrepel, patchwork, scales

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)

## ---- settings -------------------------------------------------------------
UMI_MAX    <- 4^6          # 6-nt UMI -> 4,096 possible sequences per gene (per barcode)
EX_SAMPLE  <- "^F31_FRB_IFN_S2"   # regex for the panel A library. 
CELL       <- "FRB"        # cell type for panels B and C
TRT        <- "IFN"        # treatment label as it appears in the sample names
CTRL       <- "PBS"
FC_GENE    <- "IFIT1"
B_GENES    <- c("COL1A1", "ACTB")
LABEL_GENES <- c("FN1", "TPT1", "ISG15", "ACTB", "GAPDH", "COL1A1", "IFI6", "MX1", "IFIT1")
PSEUDO     <- 1            # pseudocount (CPM) for the fold change

## ---- 1. check inputs -------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(identical(rownames(counts.phase1), rownames(umis.phase1)),
          identical(colnames(counts.phase1), colnames(umis.phase1)))

## ---- 2. CPM ----------------------------------------------------------------
umi.mat  <- as.matrix(umis.phase1)
read.mat <- as.matrix(counts.phase1)
lib.umis  <- colSums(umi.mat)
lib.reads <- colSums(read.mat)
umi.cpm  <- sweep(umi.mat,  2, lib.umis,  "/") * 1e6
read.cpm <- sweep(read.mat, 2, lib.reads, "/") * 1e6

## sample metadata 
meta <- metadata.phase1

log_breaks <- scales::trans_breaks("log10", function(x) 10^x)
log_labels <- scales::trans_format("log10", scales::math_format(10^.x))

## ---- Panel A: one library ---------------------------------------------------
s1 <- grep(EX_SAMPLE, colnames(umi.mat), value = TRUE)[1]

dA <- data.frame(gene  = rownames(umi.mat),
                 x     = read.cpm[, s1],
                 y     = umi.cpm[, s1],
                 reads = read.mat[, s1],
                 umis  = umi.mat[, s1]) %>%
  filter(x > 0, y > 0)

## slope-1 reference line anchored on unsaturated genes (read CPM 1-50):
## where every molecule would be counted, UMI CPM is proportional to read CPM
offsetA <- with(subset(dA, x > 1 & x < 50), median(log10(y) - log10(x)))
ceilA   <- UMI_MAX / lib.umis[s1] * 1e6
labA    <- filter(dA, gene %in% LABEL_GENES)
fcg     <- filter(dA, gene == FC_GENE)

pA <- ggplot(dA, aes(x, y)) +
  geom_point(color = "grey60", size = 0.4, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = offsetA, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey20") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = ceilA, linetype = "dotted", color = "firebrick") +
  geom_point(data = labA, color = "firebrick", size = 2) +
  geom_text_repel(data = labA, aes(label = gene), size = 3,
                  nudge_y = 0.8, direction = "x", segment.color = "grey40",
                  min.segment.length = 0) +
  annotate("text", x = 0, y = Inf, hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.3,
           label = sprintf("%s: %s reads \u2192 %s UMIs", FC_GENE,
                           format(fcg$reads, big.mark = ","),
                           format(fcg$umis, big.mark = ","))) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = log_breaks, labels = log_labels) +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = log_breaks, labels = log_labels) +
  labs(x = "Reads per gene / library reads (CPM)",
       y = "UMIs per gene / library UMIs (CPM)",
       title = sprintf("One library (%s): highly expressed\ngenes hit a ceiling", s1),
       caption = sprintf("dashed: expected if every molecule were counted\ndotted: ceiling of %s UMIs per gene",
                         format(UMI_MAX, big.mark = ","))) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)

## ---- Panel B: same genes across PBS libraries ------------------------------
pbs <- meta %>% filter(cell == CELL, cond == CTRL) %>% pull(sample)

dB <- expand.grid(sample = pbs, gene = B_GENES, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(lib        = lib.umis[sample],
         `UMI CPM`  = umi.cpm[cbind(gene, sample)],
         `read CPM` = read.cpm[cbind(gene, sample)]) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(`UMI CPM`, `read CPM`), names_to = "measure", values_to = "cpm") %>%
  mutate(series = paste(gene, measure, sep = ", "))

ceilB <- data.frame(lib = exp(seq(log(min(dB$lib)), log(max(dB$lib)), length.out = 100))) %>%
  mutate(cpm = UMI_MAX / lib * 1e6)

series_lv <- as.vector(outer(B_GENES, c("UMI CPM", "read CPM"), paste, sep = ", "))
shapes <- setNames(c(16, 15, 1, 0), series_lv)   # filled = UMI, open = read; circle/square per gene
cols   <- setNames(rep(c("steelblue", "firebrick"), each = 2), series_lv)

pB <- ggplot(dB, aes(lib, cpm)) +
  geom_line(data = ceilB, linetype = "dotted", color = "firebrick") +
  geom_point(aes(shape = series, color = series), size = 2, stroke = 0.8) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = shapes, breaks = series_lv, name = NULL) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols,  breaks = series_lv, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_number(scale = 1e-6, suffix = "M")) +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = log_breaks, labels = log_labels) +
  labs(x = "Library size (total UMIs)", y = "CPM",
       title = sprintf("Same genes, %d %s %s libraries: UMI CPM\nfalls as libraries get deeper; read CPM does not",
                       length(pbs), CTRL, CELL),
       caption = sprintf("dotted: %s-UMI ceiling", format(UMI_MAX, big.mark = ","))) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.3, 0.12),
        legend.background = element_blank()) +
  guides(shape = guide_legend(ncol = 2), color = guide_legend(ncol = 2))

## ---- Panel C: fold change per donor ----------------------------------------
fold_change <- function(cpm, gene) {
  meta %>%
    filter(cell == CELL, cond %in% c(TRT, CTRL)) %>%
    mutate(value = cpm[gene, sample]) %>%
    group_by(donor, cond) %>%                    # average replicates within donor
    summarise(value = mean(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = cond, values_from = value) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[TRT]]), !is.na(.data[[CTRL]])) %>%   # donors with both conditions
    mutate(lfc = log2((.data[[TRT]] + PSEUDO) / (.data[[CTRL]] + PSEUDO))) %>%
    select(donor, lfc)
}

dC <- bind_rows(UMIs  = fold_change(umi.cpm,  FC_GENE),
                Reads = fold_change(read.cpm, FC_GENE), .id = "measure") %>%
  mutate(measure = factor(measure, levels = c("UMIs", "Reads")))
medC <- dC %>% group_by(measure) %>% summarise(m = median(lfc))
nC   <- n_distinct(dC$donor)

pC <- ggplot(dC, aes(measure, lfc)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = donor), color = "grey75") +
  geom_point(aes(color = measure), size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(data = medC, aes(x = measure, ymin = m, ymax = m, color = measure),
                width = 0.35, linewidth = 1.3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = medC, aes(x = measure, y = m, label = sprintf("%.1f", m), color = measure),
            nudge_x = 0.3, size = 3.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(UMIs = "steelblue", Reads = "firebrick"), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = sprintf("%s log2 fold change, %s vs %s", FC_GENE, TRT, CTRL),
       title = sprintf("%s induction per donor\n(%d %s donors)", FC_GENE, nC, CELL)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)

## ---- assemble --------------------------------------------------------------
fig <- (pA | pB | pC) + plot_layout(widths = c(1.15, 1, 0.75)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = sprintf("6-nt UMIs allow only %s distinct molecules per gene: counts of highly expressed genes saturate",
                    format(UMI_MAX, big.mark = ",")),
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)))

ggsave("umi_saturation.png", fig, width = 18, height = 6.5, dpi = 300)
ggsave("umi_saturation.pdf", fig, width = 18, height = 6.5)
fig
```
